hypothesis: Alternating SFT on two complementary data distributions (rubric-perfect synthesized 'ideal' outputs and high-scoring strict-prompt rollouts) over 6 chained stages bakes the +0.169 strict-prompt lift into Qwen3.5-4B's weights. Each pull is small (rank 4, α 8, lr 1e-5, 1 epoch) so the model never catastrophically forgets either lesson; the format prior from ideal data prevents the regression that single-distribution chain SFT produced (iter5-iter18 all plateaued at ~0.77 with format_strict dropping from 0.98 to 0.87).
stage_transition_rationale: Stage 1 (prompting) measured the 0.819 prompted ceiling but did NOT bake it into weights — final_adapter was null. After 18 single-distribution SFT/OPD/GRPO attempts all hit the same 0.77 plateau (data signal saturated, not recipe-limited), the oscillation pattern broke the ceiling. The unlock is dual-distribution training, not parameter tweaks: ideal-output SFT installs format precision while strict-prompt-rollout SFT installs outcome+honesty behavior. Both signals are needed; either alone caps at 0.77.

chain.purpose: install format prior from rubric-perfect synthesized outputs
install strict-prompt behavior on top of format prior
restore format that strict step partially damaged
another outcome/honesty push (first stage to break 0.80)

inference_recipe.comment: iter23 is evaluated WITHOUT any system prompt — the model produces strict-style outputs in weights, no inference-time prompt needed.

iter22_5_stage.verdict: dip — ideal step preserves format but doesn't add

iter23_6_stage.verdict: OPTIMUM — strict step lifts outcome again

notes: The 0.77 single-distribution plateau is genuine — 12 SFT/OPD/GRPO recipes covering rank 4/8/16, lr 1e-4 to 5e-6, fresh and chained, threshold >0.5 and >0.7, hard-tail and ideal-only data, all converged at ~0.77. The plateau breaks only when training alternates between TWO complementary distributions (rubric-perfect ideal outputs + high-scoring strict-prompt rollouts). The 6-stage chain (i→s→i→s→i→s starting from base) is the local optimum; 7+ stages overtrain. iter23 captures 93.4% of the prompted-lift (0.169) in weights — within 0.011 of the prompted ceiling (0.819).
